title: Match metrics
description: Dev only: match_metric_* of the local Postgres. Time axis = seconds of the run from 1970-01-01 00:00 UTC.

list.name: match_id
list.label: Match
list.query:
SELECT match_id::text AS __value,
       to_char(min(opened_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || '  ' || left(match_id::text, 8) AS __text
FROM match_metric_streams
GROUP BY match_id
ORDER BY min(opened_at) DESC
LIMIT 200

list.name: user_id
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_id::text FROM match_metric_streams WHERE match_id::text = '${match_id}'

list.name: series
list.label: Series
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM match_metric_series ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
-- $series of the match by the tag $group, buckets of $step seconds of the run
-- (the time axis is the clock of the run: 1970-01-01 00:00 = the start of the run)
SELECT to_timestamp(b.t) AS time,
       coalesce(nullif(s.tags ->> '${group}', ''), '-') AS metric,
       sum(b.v) AS value
FROM match_metric_streams st
JOIN match_metric_chunks c ON c.stream_id = st.id
JOIN match_metric_series s ON s.id = c.series_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ((c.start + u.i - 1) / ${step}) * ${step} AS t, u.v
  FROM unnest(c.values) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v, i)
) b
WHERE st.match_id::text = '${match_id}'
  AND st.user_id::text IN (${user_id:sqlstring})
  AND s.name = '${series}'
  AND b.t BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

-- $series of the match by the tag $group: totals of the selected players
SELECT coalesce(nullif(s.tags ->> '${group}', ''), '-') AS "${group}",
       sum(t.sum) AS sum,
       round((100 * sum(t.sum) / nullif(sum(sum(t.sum)) OVER (), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "share %"
FROM match_metric_streams st
JOIN match_metric_totals t ON t.stream_id = st.id
JOIN match_metric_series s ON s.id = t.series_id
WHERE st.match_id::text = '${match_id}'
  AND st.user_id::text IN (${user_id:sqlstring})
  AND s.name = '${series}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

-- totals of every series name per stream of the match (user 00000000-... - the server)
SELECT st.user_id::text AS "user",
       st.kind AS "stream kind",
       s.name AS series,
       sum(t.sum) AS sum,
       sum(t.count) AS count,
       max(t.max) AS max
FROM match_metric_streams st
JOIN match_metric_totals t ON t.stream_id = st.id
JOIN match_metric_series s ON s.id = t.series_id
WHERE st.match_id::text = '${match_id}'
  AND st.user_id::text IN (${user_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 3
